fields.records/skill:3:96/description: Elite Hex Spell. For 5…21…25 seconds, target foe suffers from -1…4…5 Health degeneration, and enchantments and stances on target foe expire 20…52…60% faster. All of your non-Assassin skills are disabled for 5 seconds.
fields.records/skill:3:97/description: Elite Hex Spell. Shadow Step to target foe. For 1…6…7 seconds, that foe moves 66% slower.
fields.records/skill:3:98/description: Elite Hex Spell. Your non-Assassin skills are disabled for 3 seconds. For 1…8…10 seconds, target foe moves 50% slower. When this hex ends that foe is Crippled for 1…12…15 seconds.
fields.records/skill:3:99/description: Elite Enchantment Spell. Shadow Step to target other ally. When you stop maintaining this Enchantment, you return to your original location.
fields.records/skill:3:100/description: Elite Skill. Shadow Step to target foe. If target foe is not using a skill, that foe is knocked down. All of your non-dagger attack skills are disabled for 10 seconds.
fields.records/skill:3:101/description: Elite Spell. Target foe is struck for 20…72…85 lightning damage. If you are holding an item, you gain 7 Energy and 5…41…50 Health.
fields.records/skill:3:102/description: Elite Item Spell. Hold Glaive's ashes for up to 30…54…60 seconds. While you hold her ashes, all Ritualist skills have 20% armor penetration. When you drop her ashes, all foes in the area are struck for 15…71…85 lightning damage.
fields.records/skill:3:103/description: Elite Spell. Gain 8…15…17 Energy. If any spirits are within earshot, you do not sacrifice Health.
fields.records/skill:3:104/description: Elite Weapon Spell. For 5…17…20 seconds, target ally gains 100% more adrenaline and 1 Energy whenever that ally successfully hits with an attack.
fields.records/skill:3:105/description: Elite Signet. For 5…17…20 seconds, all spirits you control within earshot attack 33% faster and deal 5…9…10 additional damage.
fields.records/skill:3:106/description: Elite Weapon Spell. For 8 seconds, the next time target ally takes damage from a foe that damage is limited to 5% of that ally's max Health and that ally steals up to 20…68…80 Health from that foe.
fields.records/skill:3:107/description: Elite Weapon Spell. For 8 seconds, the next time target ally takes damage or life steal from a foe, that ally steals up to 20…68…80 Health from that foe and loses 2 conditions.
fields.records/skill:3:108/description: Elite Spell. All of your Spirits die. You gain 5…17…20 Energy and all of your Binding Rituals are recharged if a Spirit died in this way.
fields.records/skill:3:109/description: Elite Enchantment Spell. For 15…51…60 seconds, your attacks deal 5…29…35 more damage while under the effects of a weapon spell.
fields.records/skill:3:110/description: Elite Enchantment Spell. For 10…34…40 seconds, whenever you cast a Weapon Spell on an ally, you gain 1…4…5 Energy.
fields.records/skill:3:111/description: Elite Shout. For 4…9…10 seconds, all allies within earshot move 33% faster, and gain 5…13…15 Health while moving.
fields.records/skill:3:112/description: Elite Chant. For 10 seconds, the next attack skill used by each party member within earshot cannot be blocked.
fields.records/skill:3:113/description: Elite Chant. For 10 seconds, the next attack skill used by each ally within earshot causes Crippling for 5…13…15 seconds.
fields.records/skill:3:114/description: Elite Skill. For 10 seconds, the next time an ally within earshot would take fatal damage, that damage is negated and that ally is healed for 20…164…200 Health. Angelic Bond ends on all other allies.
fields.records/skill:3:115/description: Elite Chant. For 10 seconds, all party members within earshot gain 2…4…5 strikes of adrenaline the next time they use an attack skill.
fields.records/skill:3:116/description: Elite Chant. For 4…9…10 seconds, each party member within earshot has a 50% chance to block incoming attacks. This chant ends if that party member hits with an attack skill.
fields.records/skill:3:117/description: Elite Skill. For 45 seconds, you gain 0…120…150% more adrenaline.
fields.records/skill:3:118/description: Elite Echo. For 10…30…35 seconds, if you are under the effects of a chant or a shout, you attack 33% faster and gain 33% more adrenaline, but you have -20 armor.
fields.records/skill:3:119/description: Elite Shout. Target other ally loses all conditions. If a condition was removed in this way, that ally moves 25% faster for 1…8…10 seconds.
fields.records/skill:3:120/description: Elite Shout. For 2…4…4 seconds, all allies within earshot gain 1…2…2 Energy regeneration.
fields.records/skill:3:121/description: Elite Chant. For 20 seconds, the next 1…5…6 skills used by each ally within earshot remove 1 condition from that ally.
fields.records/skill:3:122/description: Elite Chant. For 10 seconds, the next time each party member within earshot uses a skill, that party member gains 45…97…110 Health.
fields.records/skill:3:123/description: Elite Spear Attack. If this attack hits, you deal +10…42…50 damage. If it hits a non-moving target, you inflict a Deep Wound for 5…17…20 seconds.
fields.records/skill:3:124/description: Elite Spear Attack. If this attack hits, you deal +10…42…50 damage. If it hits a foe suffering from a condition, that foe is also Dazed for 4…9…10 seconds.
fields.records/skill:3:125/description: Elite Signet. All party members lose all conditions. You are set on Fire "Fire" is capitalized, unlike other descriptions which state "set on fire" for 1 second for each condition removed in this way.
fields.records/skill:3:126/description: Elite Flash Enchantment Spell. When you cast this enchantment, all nearby foes are Blinded for 1…6…7 seconds. For 30 seconds, if you are wielding an earth weapon, your melee attacks deal +3…25…30 earth damage. When this enchantment ends, you are cured of Blindness.
fields.records/skill:3:127/description: Elite Enchantment Spell. For 15 seconds, whenever you attack a foe with your scythe, you deal 10…22…25 slashing damage to all adjacent foes.
fields.records/skill:3:128/description: Elite Enchantment Spell. For 10 seconds, whenever you cast a spell, you gain 2 Energy for each enchantment on you (maximum 2…6…7 Energy).
fields.records/skill:3:129/description: Elite Form. For 10…74…90 seconds, you gain +20 armor against physical damage, you gain adrenaline 25% faster, your attacks deal holy damage, and whenever you lose a Dervish enchantment, nearby foes are set on fire for 1…3…3 seconds. This skill is disabled for 45 seconds.
fields.records/skill:3:130/description: Elite Form. For 10…74…90 seconds, your attacks deal holy damage. Whenever you use a Dervish attack skill, you lose 1 hex. Whenever you lose a Dervish enchantment, all allies in earshot are healed for 5…41…50 Health. This skill is disabled for 45 seconds.
fields.records/skill:3:131/description: Elite Form. For 10…74…90 seconds, your scythe attacks deal dark damage, and steal 0…10…12 Health. You are immune to Disease, and inflict Disease on all adjacent foes for 3 seconds whenever you lose a Dervish enchantment. This skill is disabled for 45 seconds.
fields.records/skill:3:132/description: Elite Form. For 10…74…90 seconds, your Dervish enchantments recharge 50% faster and your attacks deal chaos damage. Whenever you lose a Dervish enchantment, steal 1 Energy from all nearby foes. This skill is disabled for 45 seconds.
fields.records/skill:3:133/description: Elite Form. For 10…74…90 seconds, you have +150 Health, +30 elemental armor, and your attacks deal earth damage. Whenever you lose a Dervish enchantment, all party members in earshot lose 1 condition. This skill is disabled for 45 seconds.
fields.records/skill:3:134/description: Elite Flash Enchantment Spell. For 8 seconds, nothing happens. When this enchantment ends, Pious Renewal is recharged and you gain 0…4…5 Energy and 0…24…30 Health.
fields.records/skill:3:135/description: Elite Enchantment Spell. For 5…9…10 seconds, you cannot be the target of spells, and you cannot cast spells.
fields.records/skill:3:136/description: Elite Scythe Attack. If this attack hits, you Cripple your target for 3…13…15 seconds. You lose 1 Dervish enchantment. If an enchantment was removed, this attack knocks down for 2…3…3 seconds.
fields.records/skill:3:137/description: Elite Scythe Attack. If this attack hits, you do +5…17…20 damage, target foe suffers from Bleeding for 5…17…20 seconds, and you lose 1 Dervish enchantment. If an enchantment is removed, target foe also suffers from a Deep Wound for 5…17…20 seconds.
fields.records/skill:3:138/description: Elite Flash Enchantment Spell. For 20 seconds, your attack skills also Cripple that foe for 1…9…11 seconds and you transfer 1…3…3 conditions from yourself to that foe.
fields.records/skill:3:139/description: Elite Flash Enchantment Spell. For 3…13…15 seconds, you attack, move and gain adrenaline 25% faster.
fields.records/skill:3:140/description: Elite Enchantment Spell. For 20 seconds, you have -2 Energy regeneration, and you gain 1…5…6 Energy every time you hit with an attack.
fields.records/skill:3:291/description: Signet. If you are within the area of a demonic servant of Abaddon, you gain 4…5 strikes of adrenaline and 22…24 Energy.
fields.records/skill:3:292/description: Elite Skill. Spit a projectile at target foe. It strikes for 400 earth damage and knocks down target foe if it hits. This skill cannot be used on nearby foes.

fields.records/skill:3:342/description: Elite Melee Attack. Attack target and adjacent foes. Each attack that hits deals +13…27…30 Holy damage for most skills, the "h" of holy is lowercase and knocks down attacking foes. PvE Skill
fields.records/skill:3:348/description: Elite Enchantment Spell. For 3…9…10 seconds, you have +1…5…6 energy regeneration. This skill reapplies itself every time you use a non-Dervish skill. PvE Skill
fields.records/skill:3:371/description: Enchantment Spell. For 4 seconds and 1 second for each rank of Critical Strikes, you attack 33% faster and gain +15…25 armor. This skill reapplies itself every time you land a critical hit.
fields.records/skill:3:372/description: Spell. Interrupt target foe's skill. If that foe was suffering from a Mesmer hex, that foe and all foes in the area take 25…50 damage and have 3…5 Health degeneration for 10 seconds.
fields.records/skill:3:373/description: Enchantment Spell. You have +100 max Health. When this enchantment ends, all party members in the area are resurrected with 40…50% Health and 20…30% Energy.
fields.records/skill:3:374/description: Skill. For 10 seconds, the next time you deal elemental damage with a spell to a target, you deal 60…70% of that damage to all other foes in the area.
fields.records/skill:3:375/description: Skill. If target foe is suffering from a condition or hex, that foe suffers 60…90 damage.
fields.records/skill:3:376/description: Skill. For 18…25 seconds, you and your pet attack 25% faster and have +1…3 Health regeneration.
fields.records/skill:3:377/description: Enchantment Spell. For 2…5 seconds, whenever target other ally takes damage, all party members are healed for 2 Health for each rank in Divine Favor.
fields.records/skill:3:378/description: Binding Ritual. Create a level 4…14 spirit that dies after 75…150 seconds. Attacks by this spirit steal up to 10…20 Health, and you are healed for 10…20 Health.
fields.records/skill:3:379/description: Melee Attack. Attack target and adjacent foes. Each attack that hits deals +13…20 damage.
fields.records/skill:3:380/description: Shout. For 4 seconds and 1 second for every 2 ranks in Leadership, all party members within earshot take 20…35% less damage. Affected party members are healed for 35…60 Health when this shout ends.
fields.records/skill:4:1/description: Elite Axe Attack. If this attack hits, you strike for +10…34…40 damage and hit 1…2…2 adjacent foes for 10…34…40 slashing damage.
fields.records/skill:4:293/description: Skill. For 30 seconds you have +2…3 Health regeneration. If you are drunk when activating this skill, you also have +200…300 maximum Health.
fields.records/skill:4:294/description: Elite Form. You lose all effects and take on the aspect of the raven. For 60 seconds, you have 80 armor, 660…700 Health, and a 20…30% chance to block, All your attributes are set to 0 and raven attacks replace your skills.
fields.records/skill:4:295/description: Elite Form. You lose all effects and take on the aspect of the bear. For 60 seconds, you have 100 armor and 750…790…800 Health. All your attributes are set to 0 and bear attacks replace your skills.
fields.records/skill:4:296/description: Elite Form. You lose all effects and take on the aspect of the wolf. For 60 seconds, you have 80 armor, 660…700 Health, and 2…4 Health regeneration. All your attributes are set to 0 and wolf attacks replace your skills.
fields.records/skill:4:297/description: Skill. For 20…30 seconds you gain a random Asura benefit every time you earn experience from killing an enemy.
fields.records/skill:4:298/description: Hex Spell. For 9…12 seconds your attacks cannot miss target foe. Killing a foe hexed with Asuran Scan removes 5% Death Penalty.
fields.records/skill:4:299/description: Enchantment Spell. For 5…11 seconds you have a 50% chance to block attacks. This Enchantment is reapplied every time an enemy strikes you.
fields.records/skill:4:300/description: Enchantment Spell. For 10…16 seconds, you move 20…33% faster and your Spells take 20% less time to cast.
fields.records/skill:4:301/description: Hex Spell. For 6…10 seconds, every time target foe deals damage that foe takes 100…140% of the damage it causes (maximum 80 damage).
fields.records/skill:4:302/description: Ward Spell. For 5 seconds, foes in the area have -4…6 Health degeneration. When the portal ends, foes in the area are Diseased for 12…20 seconds.
fields.records/skill:4:303/description: Spell. For 10…20 seconds, one random spell is disabled for target foe and Smooth Criminal is replaced by that spell. You gain 5…10 Energy.
fields.records/skill:4:304/description: Spell. Summon a level 14…20 Ice Imp that lives for 40…60 seconds and has Ice Spikes. Only 1 Asura Summon can be active a time.
fields.records/skill:4:305/description: Spell. Summon a level 14…20 Mursaat that lives for 40…60 seconds and has Enervating Charge. Only 1 Asura Summon can be active at a time.
fields.records/skill:4:306/description: Spell. Summon a level 14…20 Naga Shaman that lives for 40…60 seconds and has Stoning. Only 1 Asura Summon can be active a time.
fields.records/skill:4:307/description: Spell. Summon a level 14…20 Ruby Djinn that lives for 40…60 seconds and has Immolate. Only 1 Asura Summon can be active at a time.
fields.records/skill:4:308/description: Spell. Target foe and all adjacent foes are struck for 30…40 damage. If target foe is not a boss, that foe and all adjacent foes are Dazed for 3…5 seconds.
fields.records/skill:4:309/description: Spell. Throw Alkar's Alchemical Acid at target foe. Target and adjacent foes are struck for 40…50 damage. Destroyers take an additional 45…70 damage and they have Cracked Armor for 14…20 seconds.

fields.records/skill:4:311/description: Skill. You headbutt target touched foe dealing 45…70 damage and knocking down that foe if it hits.
fields.records/skill:4:312/description: Spell. All party members are relieved of Burning and are healed for 50…60 Health.
fields.records/skill:4:313/description: Stance. For 72…90 seconds, your movement and attack speeds are increased by 10…15%. If you are drunk while activating this skill, your movement and attack speeds are increased by 25…33% instead.
fields.records/skill:4:314/description: Enchantment Spell. For 24…30 seconds, your stances last 55…100% longer. If you activated this skill while drunk, you cannot be knocked down.
fields.records/skill:4:315/description: Skill. Target touched foe takes 50…70 piercing damage and begins Bleeding for 15…25 seconds.
fields.records/skill:4:316/description: Weapon Spell. For 20 seconds, target other ally's weapon strikes for +15…20 damage and has a 28…40% chance to cause knock down.
fields.records/skill:4:317/description: Spell. All foes in the area are struck for 55…80 holy damage. The location of hidden objects are briefly indicated on your Compass. Any hidden objects in the area are revealed.
fields.records/skill:4:318/description: Spell. Create a Snow Storm at target foe's location. For 5 seconds, foes adjacent to that location are struck for 30…40 cold damage each second.
fields.records/skill:4:319/description: Ranged Attack. If this attack hits, target foe takes 18…30 damage. If that foe has Cracked Armor, it begins Bleeding for 18…30 seconds.
fields.records/skill:4:320/description: Ward Spell. You plant an Ebon Battle Standard of Honor at your current location. For 14…20 seconds, non-spirit allies in this area strike for +8…15 damage and an additional +7…10 vs. Charr.
fields.records/skill:4:321/description: Spell. Shadow Step to target other ally. You and that other ally are healed for 70…110 health.
fields.records/skill:4:322/description: Spell. Target foe is struck for 54…90 piercing damage and begins Bleeding for 5…25 seconds. This attack has a 10% chance of doing an additional +540…900 piercing damage. If this attack hits a Charr it has a 25% chance of doing an additional +540…900 piercing damage.
fields.records/skill:4:323/description: Signet. For 14…20 seconds, target foe and all adjacent foes move and attack 23…40% slower.
fields.records/skill:4:324/description: Trap. When Weakness Trap is triggered, all nearby foes are Weakened for 10…20 seconds and take 24…50 lightning damage. All Charr are knocked down. Weakness Trap ends after 90 seconds. While activating this skill, you are easily interrupted.
fields.records/skill:4:325/description: Ebon Vanguard Ritual. Create a level 4…10 Spirit. All foes within its range have 15% chance to miss with ranged attacks. This spirit dies after 54…90 seconds.
fields.records/skill:4:326/description: Ward Spell. You plant an Ebon Battle Standard of Courage at your current location. For 14…20 seconds, non-spirit allies in this area gain +24 armor and an additional +24 armor against Charr.
fields.records/skill:4:327/description: Ward Spell. You plant an Ebon Battle Standard of Wisdom at your current location. For 14…20 seconds, non-spirit allies in this area have a 44…60% chance to halve skill recharge of spells they cast.
fields.records/skill:4:328/description: Spell. Summon a level 14…20 Ebon Vanguard Assassin that has Iron Palm, Fox Fangs, and Nine Tail Strike. This summoned Assassin Shadow Steps to target foe. If that foe is a Charr, the Assassin lives for 24…30 seconds. If target foe is not a Charr, the Assassin lives for 12…15 seconds.
fields.records/skill:4:329/description: Signet. If target foe is Bleeding, that foe is Diseased for 13…20 seconds.
fields.records/skill:4:330/description: Melee Attack. If this attack hits, target foe is Blinded for 5…8 seconds. This attack counts as a lead attack.
fields.records/skill:4:331/description: Signet. For 14…20 seconds, target foe and all adjacent foes move and attack 23…40% slower.
fields.records/skill:4:332/description: Hex Spell. Target touched foe takes 44…80 damage. If target foe was knocked down, that foe cannot attack for 5…8 seconds.
fields.records/skill:4:333/description: Melee Attack. If this attack hits, it deals +6…9 damage for each adjacent foe (maximum 60 damage). If target foe is non-human it is knocked down.
fields.records/skill:4:334/description: Shout. For 16…20 seconds, your next attack cannot be blocked and does +14…20 damage.
fields.records/skill:4:335/description: Shout. If target foe has less than 50% Health, that foe takes 44…80 damage and suffers from Cracked Armor and a Deep Wound for 12…20 seconds.
fields.records/skill:4:336/description: Shout. Your next 5…8 attacks do an additional +14…20 damage.
fields.records/skill:4:337/description: Shout. For 16…20 seconds, you have +24 armor and cannot be knocked down or Crippled.
fields.records/skill:4:338/description: Shout. Target foe and foes adjacent to target are Weakened for 8…12 seconds.
fields.records/skill:4:339/description: Shout. Target foe is knocked down and takes 44…80 damage. That foe is also Crippled for 8…15 seconds.
fields.records/skill:4:340/description: Elite Shout. For 3…13…15 seconds, all party members near you or near your pet deal +5…13…15 additional damage with attacks and gain +1…6…7 Health regeneration. PvE Skill

Description: A Charr Bag is an equippable item that provides 10 additional inventory spaces. Because they already hold 10 items, they cannot be upgraded by using a Rune of Holding. A Superior Rune of Holding can be applied to it after leaving Pre-Searing and make it hold 15 items. A character may wear up to 2 bags at one time. Bags are not visible to other players.

Charr Bags are most commonly used by players in Pre-Searing who, without access to storage, have little inventory space.

Acquisition: * Ascalon (pre-Searing)
** The Northlands
***Warrior Scarl the Slicer
***Monk Blaze Bloodbane 
***Necromancer Red Eye the Unholy
***Mesmer Ghast Ashpyre
***Elementalist Jaw Smokeskin
* Depths of Tyria
** Forsaken Tunnels
***Warrior Charr Patrol Leader
***Warrior Wyle Brimscourge
***Elementalist Maz Scourgeheart
***Maz's Chest

Wiki notes: * Charr Bags use the same inventory icon as Jun's Art Supplies, Tasca's Pack, and Zehtuka's Pack.
* They appear to have the same model as the backpacks carried by some Merchants.
* This item cannot be dyed.
* Empty bags can be moved into other, equipped bags, or into your storage, but as with any other container, they cannot be unequipped until you remove all items.
fields.records/green:1:8c5c9f712b06ef37/details: Description: A Charr Salvage Kit is a type of kit that provides the only method for pre-Searing characters to obtain upgrade components. They look and work the same as Expert Salvage Kits; however, they have only five uses and they can only be obtained as drops from one of the Charr bosses or Maz's Chest.

Acquisition: * Ascalon (pre-Searing)
** The Northlands
***Warrior Scarl the Slicer
***Monk Blaze Bloodbane 
***Necromancer Red Eye the Unholy
***Mesmer Ghast Ashpyre
***Elementalist Jaw Smokeskin
* Depths of Tyria
** Forsaken Tunnels
***Warrior Charr Patrol Leader
***Warrior Wyle Brimscourge
***Elementalist Maz Scourgeheart
***Maz's Chest

Wiki notes: * This kit used to be the only means of salvaging equipment modifiers while in pre-Searing Ascalon, including weapon upgrades, Runes, or Insignias. With the introduction of The Purveyor players are able to obtain the Infinite Superior Salvage Kit in pre-Searing Ascalon.
* As with any kit, its value will decrease proportionally as it is used.
* Although it is gold, identifying it will not contribute to the Wisdom title track (however it will increase the value of the kit if sold to a merchant).
* These kits can be used to salvage rare crafting materials, but there is no point in doing so: rare materials cannot be used in pre-Searing Ascalon.
* The base chance, before the Wisdom and Treasure Hunter bonuses, of breaking an item upon salvaging an upgrade is 50%.

Description: This sword shares a similar shape with the Violet Edge and Emerald Edge. Three things distinguish these oddly shaped swords from one another; the first and most noticeable is the color. The Violet Edge is purple in color, the Emerald Edge is green, and the Cerulean Edge is a light blue. Secondly, the small golden orb located above the grip in the first curve of the blade is held in place by braces; on the Violet Edge, one brace holds it in place, on the Emerald, two settings hold it, and on the Cerulean Edge, three braces securely fasten it. Lastly, the three Edges differ slightly in size, with the Violet being the smallest, the Emerald being slightly longer, and the Cerulean being the largest.

Acquisition: ;Eye Of The North
*Depths of Tyria
**Ooze Pit
***Prismatic Chest

To find the Rainbow Phoenix in the Hall of Monuments, a character must satisfy the following conditions:
- Having all four Monumental Tapestries added to his/her Hall of Monuments.
- Having achieved the second tier of the maxed titles track, "People Know Me", or greater.
- Entering the area alone. No other players, no heroes, no henchmen.

fields.records/skill:0:1/skill/description: Elite Axe Attack. If this attack hits, you strike for +10…34…40 damage and hit 1…2…2 adjacent foes for 10…34…40 slashing damage.
fields.records/skill:0:2/skill/description: Elite Hammer Attack. If Devastating Hammer hits, your target is knocked down and suffers from Weakness for 5…17…20 seconds.
fields.records/skill:0:3/skill/description: Elite Stance. For 5…17…20 seconds, you move 33% faster and gain double adrenaline from attacks. Battle Rage ends if you use any non-adrenal skills.
fields.records/skill:0:4/skill/description: Elite Skill. For 15 seconds, whenever you attack with a sword, all adjacent foes take 10…30…35 slashing damage.
fields.records/skill:0:5/skill/description: Elite Shout. Allies in earshot lose the Crippled condition. For 5…11…13 seconds, these allies move 33% faster.
fields.records/skill:0:6/skill/description: Elite Pet Attack. Your animal companion attempts a Ferocious Strike that deals +13…25…28 damage. If that attack hits, you gain adrenaline and 3…9…10 Energy.
fields.records/skill:0:7/skill/description: Elite Stance. For 1…7…8 seconds, you move 33% faster and have a 75% chance to block attacks.
fields.records/skill:0:8/skill/description: Elite Bow Attack. All your preparations are removed. Shoot arrows at target foe and up to 5 foes adjacent to your target. These arrows strike for +5…17…20 damage if they hit.
fields.records/skill:0:9/skill/description: Elite Trap. When Spike Trap is triggered, every second (for 2 seconds), all nearby foes are struck for 10…34…40 piercing damage, become Crippled for 3…21…25 seconds, and are knocked down. Spike Trap ends after 90 seconds. While activating this skill, you are easily interrupted.
fields.records/skill:0:10/skill/description: Elite Bow Attack. Shoot an arrow that moves twice as fast.
fields.records/skill:0:11/skill/description: Elite Enchantment Spell. For 5…15…17 seconds, target ally cannot be the target of enemy spells.
fields.records/skill:0:12/skill/description: Elite Spell. Heal target ally for 5…81…100 Health. Heal for an additional 30…98…115 Health if that ally is below 50% Health.
fields.records/skill:0:13/skill/description: Elite Enchantment Spell. For 5…11…13 seconds, target ally gains +3…9…10 Health regeneration and 20…40…45 armor.
fields.records/skill:0:14/skill/description: Elite Signet. Target foe is knocked down. That foe and all adjacent foes take 15…63…75 holy damage.
fields.records/skill:0:15/skill/description: Elite Spell. Transfer all conditions and their remaining durations from your allies to you.
fields.records/skill:0:16/skill/description: Elite Enchantment Spell. For 10 seconds, target other ally gains +3…5…6 Energy regeneration.
fields.records/skill:0:17/skill/description: Elite Hex Spell. For 6…25…30 seconds, target foe and all nearby foes suffer -1…3…4 Health degeneration, and gain 25% less benefit from healing.
fields.records/skill:0:18/skill/description: Elite Signet. Transfer all negative conditions with 100…180…200% of their remaining durations from yourself to target foe. (50% failure chance with Curses 4 or less.)
fields.records/skill:0:19/skill/description: Elite Enchantment Spell. For 20…39…44 seconds, allies in the area are immune to disease, and anyone striking those allies in melee becomes Diseased for 3…13…15 seconds.
fields.records/skill:0:20/skill/description: Elite Spell. If target foe has more Health than you, you gain half the difference (up to your maximum Health), and that foe loses an equal amount. If this foe has less Health than you, you lose half the difference, and that foe gains an equal amount.
fields.records/skill:0:21/skill/description: Elite Spell. Target foe loses 1…8…10 Energy. For each point of Energy lost, that foe takes 7 damage and all nearby foes take 75% of that damage.
fields.records/skill:0:22/skill/description: Elite Stance. For 5…17…20 seconds, spells you cast recharge 33% faster.
fields.records/skill:0:23/skill/description: Elite Hex Spell. For 5…17…20 seconds, target moves and attacks 50% slower and suffers -1…7…8 Health degeneration.
fields.records/skill:0:24/skill/description: Elite Spell. Target foe loses 2…8…9 Energy. You gain 3 Energy for each point of Energy lost.
fields.records/skill:0:25/skill/description: Elite Enchantment Spell. For 30 seconds, Echo is replaced with the next skill you use. Echo acts as this skill for 30 seconds.
fields.records/skill:0:26/skill/description: Elite Hex Spell. After 3 seconds, target foe is knocked down and struck for 14…83…100 lightning damage, and has Cracked Armor for 5…17…20 seconds. This spell has 25% armor penetration.
fields.records/skill:0:27/skill/description: Elite Enchantment Spell. For 8…18…20 seconds, you gain +20 armor and cannot be the target of enemy spells, but cannot attack and have -2 energy degeneration.
fields.records/skill:0:28/skill/description: Elite Enchantment Spell. For 25…53…60 seconds, you are attuned to Air, Fire, Water, and Earth and gain +1…2…2 to these attributes. You gain 1 Energy plus 50% of the base Energy cost of the skill each time you use magic associated with any of these elements.
fields.records/skill:0:29/skill/description: Elite Spell. Target foe and all adjacent foes take 15…51…60 fire damage. If you have more Energy than target foe, that foe and all adjacent foes take an additional 15…51…60 fire damage and are set on fire for 1…8…10 seconds.
fields.records/skill:0:30/skill/description: Elite Hex Spell. Target foe takes 10…50…60 cold damage. If you have more Energy than target foe, that foe suffers an additional 10…50…60 cold damage and moves 90% slower for 1…4…5 seconds.
fields.records/skill:0:293/skill/description: Skill. For 30 seconds you have +2…3 Health regeneration. If you are drunk when activating this skill, you also have +200…300 maximum Health.
fields.records/skill:1:141/skill/description: Elite Axe Attack. If Eviscerate hits, you strike for +10…38…45 damage and inflict a Deep Wound, lowering your target's maximum Health by 20% for 5…17…20 seconds.
fields.records/skill:1:142/skill/description: Elite Hammer Attack. If Backbreaker hits, you strike for +1…16…20 damage and your target is knocked down. If you have 8 Strength or higher, this knockdown lasts 4 seconds.
fields.records/skill:1:143/skill/description: Elite Hammer Attack. Target foe and all adjacent foes are knocked down. (50% failure chance with Hammer Mastery 4 or less.)
fields.records/skill:1:144/skill/description: Elite Stance. For 1…6…7 seconds, you move 50% faster and if you strike a moving foe in melee, that foe is knocked down. Bull's Charge ends if you use a skill.
fields.records/skill:1:145/skill/description: Elite Skill. For 20 seconds you have an additional 90…258…300 Health, an additional 20 armor, and you take -1…8…10 less damage.
fields.records/skill:1:146/skill/description: Elite Stance. For 5…10…11 seconds, if you are wielding a hammer, you attack 33% faster, you gain +40 armor, and your attack skills interrupt foes when they hit.
fields.records/skill:1:147/skill/description: Elite Skill. All of your attack skills become recharged. You gain 2…6…7 Energy for each skill recharged by Flourish.
fields.records/skill:1:148/skill/description: Elite Skill. For 5…29…35 seconds, you gain 3 Energy each time you hit with a melee attack. Warrior's Endurance cannot raise your Energy above 10…22…25.
fields.records/skill:1:149/skill/description: Elite Stance. For 5…10…11 seconds, you have a 75% chance to block incoming attacks. Whenever you block a melee attack this way, the attacker suffers 5…29…35 damage.
fields.records/skill:1:150/skill/description: Elite Shout. You gain 10…56…68 Health and 3…6…7 Energy for each condition suffered by target foe.
fields.records/skill:1:151/skill/description: Elite Melee Attack. If it hits, this attack interrupts the target's current action. If that foe was casting a spell, that foe is Dazed for 15 seconds.
fields.records/skill:1:152/skill/description: Elite Preparation. For 18 seconds, you gain 5…9…10 Energy whenever your arrows hit, but lose 10 Energy whenever your arrows fail to strike.
fields.records/skill:1:153/skill/description: Elite Bow Attack. If Oath Shot hits, all of your skills except Oath Shot are recharged. If it misses, all of your skills are disabled for 10…5…4 seconds. (50% miss chance with Expertise 7 or less.)
fields.records/skill:1:154/skill/description: Elite Stance. For 20…32…35 seconds, your Preparations recharge 50% faster and last 30…246…300% longer.
fields.records/skill:1:155/skill/description: Elite Bow Attack. If Crippling Shot hits, your target becomes Crippled for 4…12…14 seconds. This attack cannot be blocked.
fields.records/skill:1:156/skill/description: Elite Bow Attack. If Punishing Shot hits, you strike for +10…18…20 damage and your target is interrupted.

fields.records/skill:0:1/skill/warnings/0/text: Contrary to the descriptions, damage is dealt to an additional 2…3…3 foes.
fields.records/skill:0:16/skill/warnings/0/text: Heroes will spam this skill on allies with heavy overcast, regardless of what percentage of energy the ally has.
fields.records/skill:0:19/skill/warnings/0/text: Although this is a PBAoE skill with an effect centered around the caster, it still needs an allied target and you will run towards that target if not in cast range. Similar to Hex Eater Signet, the target won't be affected if it is not in range.
fields.records/skill:0:19/skill/warnings/1/text: Because it is a targeted enchantment spell, it will always trigger Shame and Mark of Subversion. If standing in a Well of the Profane, you will be able to cast this enchantment if you pick any ally in cast range that is not inside the well.
fields.records/skill:0:20/skill/warnings/0/text: The concise description omits the fact that your health gain (and your target's health loss) is capped by your maximum health.
fields.records/skill:0:25/skill/warnings/0/text: Echo's description omits the fact that it cannot copy a Signet of Capture and itself.
fields.records/skill:0:27/skill/warnings/0/text: The armor bonus from this skill only applies to physical damage.
fields.records/skill:0:29/skill/warnings/0/text: This skill checks the energy condition independently for each target hit.
fields.records/skill:1:157/skill/warnings/0/tex: Unlike Winter this skill requires the attacker to be inside the spirit area of effect.
fields.records/skill:1:157/skill/warnings/1/tex: Does not properly convert the physical damage of certain skills (notably: Ebon Vanguard Sniper Support and Veil of Thorns). As a result, the skill chain will not trigger the conditional effects of other skills that depend on fire damage (in particular, for Intensity).
fields.records/skill:1:163/skill/warnings/0/tex: Contrary to the description, Peace and Harmony doesn't cause conditions and hexes to expire 90% faster. Instead, all new conditions and hexes, applied during the enchantment, will have their duration reduced by 90%.
fields.records/skill:1:164/skill/warnings/0/tex: The tiny delay between the target being teleported to the casters location and being resurrected is long enough for an AI to possibly use "We Shall Return!", which takes place before UA's resurrecting effect.
fields.records/skill:1:164/skill/warnings/1/tex: The "random" resurrected party member is almost always the one closest to the caster when the skill is cancelled. You can therefor pick which target to rez by moving on top of the corpse before cancelling.
fields.records/skill:1:164/skill/warnings/2/tex: If you are moving when it ends, the resurrected party member will be teleported to where you started running or where you last changed direction, not to your current position.
fields.records/skill:1:165/skill/warnings/0/tex: Contrary to the descriptions, this skill causes health gain and not healing.
fields.records/skill:1:168/skill/warnings/0/tex: Contrary to the description, this skill causes health gain and not healing.
fields.records/skill:1:171/skill/warnings/0/tex: Shield of Judgment will not be listed in the damage monitor if its damage is reduced to 0.
fields.records/skill:1:171/skill/warnings/1/tex: The concise description states that foes attacking target ally will be knocked down and suffer damage; however, this effect only occurs when the target ally is successfully hit.
fields.records/skill:1:172/skill/warnings/0/tex: The concise description fails to mention that the regeneration is gained for each hexed foe.
fields.records/skill:1:182/skill/warnings/0/tex: Also interrupts passive charmable animals when they are near a foe hexed with Panic.
fields.records/skill:1:184/skill/warnings/0/tex: Applying or reapplying the hex on a target suffering from one or more condition(s) will trigger the Dazed effect.
fields.records/skill:1:184/skill/warnings/1/tex: The Dazed caused by this hex is always spread to foes in the area, even if the target was already Dazed.
fields.records/skill:1:184/skill/warnings/2/tex: The Dazed caused by this hex triggers Fragility twice upon application on the target (but not on surrounding foes).
fields.records/skill:1:184/skill/warnings/3/tex: If two foes hexed with Fevered Dreams are next to each other and one of them starts suffering from a new condition, both will be Dazed.
fields.records/skill:1:185/skill/warnings/0/tex: Similarly to "I Am Unstoppable!" and Mantra of Signets, the armor provided by this skill is only applied at the end of the armor calculation. As such, it is not counted in the bonus armor cap of +25 and is not reduced by Armor penetration.
fields.records/skill:1:187/skill/warnings/0/tex: Similar to Deadly Paradox, Migraine does not affect attack skill activation times.
fields.records/skill:1:187/skill/warnings/1/tex: Monsters won't cast Migraine on you when at least five of your skills are recharging.
fields.records/skill:1:188/skill/warnings/0/tex: Some non-English descriptions incorrectly expand the area of effect beyond adjacent foes: the French full description adds nearby foes and the German concise description adds the target.
fields.records/skill:1:188/skill/warnings/1/tex: At ranks 0-1 Fast Casting, all signets activated within the duration will deal damage and interrupt foes.
fields.records/skill:1:191/skill/warnings/0/tex: The concise description fails to specify the duration of the Blind condition
fields.records/skill:1:191/skill/warnings/1/tex: Unlike most area damage over time skills, Glimmering Mark does not cause AI to scatter.
fields.records/skill:1:195/skill/warnings/0/tex: Contrary to the descriptions, this skill causes healing and not health gain.
fields.records/skill:1:197/skill/warnings/0/tex: This skill does not actually become disabled, as it can be instantly recharged by Glyph of Renewal, and the recharge reduced by Glyph of Swiftness.
fields.records/skill:1:346/skill/warnings/0/tex: The health sacrifice does not appear on the damage monitor.

fields.records/skill:2:209/skill/warnings/0/tex: This skill has no aftercast delay.
fields.records/skill:2:214/skill/warnings/0/tex: This skill does not increase the amount of time a target is burning from Glyph of Immolation nor Mark of Rodgort.
fields.records/skill:2:224/skill/warnings/0/tex: Contrary to the descriptions, this skill causes healing in earshot and not health gain.
fields.records/skill:2:227/skill/warnings/0/tex: Contrary to the full description, this skill causes healing and not health gain.
fields.records/skill:2:228/skill/warnings/0/tex: Unlike other recurring ground AOE skills, AI units often will not try to leave until the effect is nearly expired.
fields.records/skill:2:230/skill/warnings/0/tex: Unlike other healing skills, this spell can target spirits to remove burning. However, Empathic Removal will not heal the spirits.
fields.records/skill:2:231/skill/warnings/0/tex: Causes bleeding when non-fleshy creatures, such as Shadow Vaettirs, cast Necromancer spells.
fields.records/skill:2:233/skill/warnings/0/tex: Similar to other enchantments that target a foe, foes affected by Well of the Profane or spirits cannot be targeted by this enchantment.
fields.records/skill:2:237/skill/warnings/0/tex: On some very rare occasions, living NPCs will spawn rather than corpses when the golem dies.
fields.records/skill:2:241/skill/warnings/0/tex: Contrary to the concise description, the interrupt does not need to succeed for the skill to become disabled.
fields.records/skill:2:253/skill/warnings/0/tex: The skill description implies that Blind covers Cracked Armor which covers Weakness, while in actuality Blind covers Weakness which covers Cracked Armor.
fields.records/skill:2:255/skill/warnings/0/tex: Changing your maximum energy lower than what it was when this was cast on you, will lower your health bonus accordingly to your new energy, however swapping back to higher energy will not bring it back up and it will remain at the lower amount, even if recast on you at higher energy before its duration ends.
fields.records/skill:2:256/skill/warnings/0/tex: If a foe with a spell targeting prevention skill is targeted, Double Dragon will fail, despite the enchantment applying to the ally nearest to the target foe.
fields.records/skill:2:256/skill/warnings/1/tex: Whenever a target under the effects of Double Dragon is interrupted, the animation restarts.
fields.records/skill:2:256/skill/warnings/2/tex: Unlike most area damage over time skills, Double Dragon does not cause AI to scatter.
fields.records/skill:2:257/skill/warnings/0/tex: In the Polish translation, description was not updated when skill functionality changed. It still says: You lose 5 Energy if more than one foe is struck.
fields.records/skill:2:265/skill/warnings/0/tex: The non-concise description is wrong, attacks blocked by another blocking source while under the effects of this skill and while attacking will still trigger the damage.
fields.records/skill:2:273/skill/warnings/0/tex: The -5 damage reduction is active for the expected duration of each enchantment, not its actual duration. Refreshing an Assassin enchantment before it ends reduces the received damage by an additional -5.
fields.records/skill:2:275/skill/warnings/0/tex: Similar to other enchantments that target a foe, foes affected by Well of the Profane or spirits cannot be targeted by this enchantment.
fields.records/skill:2:283/skill/warnings/0/tex: Contrary to the concise description, this skill's conditional effect causes health gain and not healing.
fields.records/skill:2:288/skill/warnings/0/tex: Ritual Lord will only increase the skill progression of a skill, and not inherent effects from Spawning Power.
fields.records/skill:2:351/skill/warnings/0/tex: With skills that remove "all enchantments" (such as Contemplation of Purity), an instance of this skill's damage will trigger for each Dervish enchantment except for Eternal Aura, Shield of Force, Grenth's Aura, or Vow of Revolution. By contrast, there is no restriction on which Dervish enchantments will trigger damage if a specific number of enchantments is removed (such as by Rend Enchantments or Dervish teardowns), as long as they cover Aura of Holy Might (plus Aura of Holy Might itself).

fields.records/skill:3:35/skill/warnings/0/text: Against unenchanted targets this skill causes block bypassing effects such as Asuran Scan or Warrior's Cunning to be ignored.
fields.records/skill:3:41/skill/warnings/0/text: The full description omits that this skill needs your pet to be alive to activate.
fields.records/skill:3:42/skill/warnings/0/text: Targeting yourself or an ally will sometimes cause your pet to stop moving. It will unfreeze when an opponent enters your aggro bubble or attacks it. This is exploited to perform the portal jumping technique known as a SaO chain.
fields.records/skill:3:42/skill/warnings/1/text: Strike as One's description omits the fact that it has a limited duration of 30 seconds.
fields.records/skill:3:42/skill/warnings/2/text: The French description of the skill mention an "enemy target" for the shadow step despite the fact that the skill can target either foe or friend
fields.records/skill:3:44/skill/warnings/0/text: Does not double adrenaline gain from all sources as stated, but rather gives one additional strike of adrenaline per attack. Despite this, it still does not stack with other skills that increase the rate of adrenaline gain, such as "For Great Justice!" or Weapon of Fury, but stacks additively with Mark of Fury or Dark Fury.
fields.records/skill:3:58/skill/warnings/0/text: Doesn't work against Psychic Instability or Tremor.
fields.records/skill:3:65/skill/warnings/0/text: Even though it has no activation time, this signet (similar to Dolyak Signet) cannot be used while knocked down or performing an action.
fields.records/skill:3:65/skill/warnings/1/text: After being resurrected, if the player uses the skill in the middle of the stand up animation they will not begin bleeding.
fields.records/skill:3:67/skill/warnings/0/text: The descriptions do not mention the duration of the bleeding inflicted by the Jagged Horror.
fields.records/skill:3:68/skill/warnings/0/text: This skill can not be cast if you are targeting someone under Spell Breaker, Vow of Silence etc. and triggers the spell Mistrust, acting like a target foe spell.
fields.records/skill:3:77/skill/warnings/0/text: If an enchantment duration is reduced below 1 second, it behaves as if it was not applied.
fields.records/skill:3:77/skill/warnings/1/text: Although the description says "150…270…300% faster", the actual behavior is "at 150…270…300% the normal rate", which is only 50…170…200% faster.
fields.records/skill:3:80/skill/warnings/0/text: Items that grant a 20% chance of adding +1 to Illusion Magic do not affect spells cast while this signet is active. For example, you cannot use "Master of My Domain" to obtain rank 21 in the table above. Instead, spells will use the unmodified Illusion rank.
fields.records/skill:3:81/skill/warnings/0/text: Unlike all other Elementalist skills that deal both damage and additional damage (except Sandstorm and Teinai's Wind), this skill's additional damage is not dealt in a separate packet.
fields.records/skill:3:82/skill/warnings/0/text: Invoke Lightning's animation shows strikes on all possible targets, not just the three that are actually hit.
fields.records/skill:3:83/skill/warnings/0/text: Unlike all other Elementalist skills that deal both damage and additional damage (except Blinding Surge and Teinai's Wind), this skill's additional damage is not dealt in a separate packet.
fields.records/skill:3:86/skill/warnings/0/text: While under the effects of Master of Magic, being weakened with attribute points in elemental ranks will cause elemental ranks to lower by 1. Elemental attributes without attribute points in will not lower by 1.
fields.records/skill:3:94/skill/warnings/0/text: This skill replaces your dagger's attack damage with the stated damage, which is non-armor-ignoring damage (unlike other attack skills such as Distracting Shot and Needling Shot). This damage is affected by Dagger Mastery, critical hits, armor penetration, inscription and inscription-equivalent weapon damage bonuses and the target's armor rating, but does not benefit from the customization damage bonus.
fields.records/skill:3:95/skill/warnings/0/text: The concise description fails to mention that only daze will not have effect if not enchanted (the attack will not fail).
fields.records/skill:3:98/skill/warnings/0/text: Crippling modifiers on weapons do not extend the duration of cripple caused by the end effect.
fields.records/skill:3:99/skill/warnings/0/text: This spell does not have an aftercast delay.
fields.records/skill:3:102/skill/warnings/0/tex: When dropped, the chat log notes your dropping the ashes as "You drop a Destructive was Glaive." When most ashes from an item spell are dropped, the chat log notes this as "You drop an Ashes of..." followed by the name of the item spell. Example: "You drop an Ashes of Grasping Kuurong."
fields.records/skill:3:107/skill/warnings/0/tex: If used when taking damage from multiple sources from only one attack, Weapon of Remedy will trigger multiple times. For example, if a foe hexed with Barbs takes physical damage, Weapon of Remedy will trigger both for the physical damage and for the Barbs damage.
fields.records/skill:3:114/skill/warnings/0/tex: The skill states it will end on all other allies, however, it will only end on party members of the ally that it triggers on, not all allies.
fields.records/skill:3:114/skill/warnings/1/tex: Despite the skill descriptions, this skill triggers with health degeneration, health loss, life stealing, and health sacrifice, not just damage.
fields.records/skill:3:117/skill/warnings/0/tex: Unlike most skills that increase the rate of adrenaline gain by a multiplier, this increases all non-multiplier sources of adrenaline, not just the basic 1 strike from making an attack.
fields.records/skill:3:118/skill/warnings/0/tex: Similar to Cracked Armor, this skill will not lower your armor rating below 60 or your "core" armor rating, if your "core" armor rating is lower than 60.
fields.records/skill:3:118/skill/warnings/1/tex: If you use a skill or combination of skills and effects that grant +46 or more armor rating, Soldier's Fury's armor penalty does not function. See also armor calculation.
fields.records/skill:3:119/skill/warnings/0/tex: If a condition is removed, Leadership will restore energy as if it affected two targets, requiring minimum 8 Leadership to receive the doubled benefit. This causes it to have a net cost of 1 energy.
fields.records/skill:3:121/skill/warnings/0/tex: Re-application does not reset the number of uses remaining until the original application would have ended. It appears to count any skill uses against both applications, and the chant will end if the number of uses remaining from the original application reaches 0.
fields.records/skill:3:125/skill/warnings/0/tex: Although the effect extends beyond party range, the AI only considers allies within the expected range.
fields.records/skill:3:128/skill/warnings/0/tex: This skill currently only grants 1 energy per enchantment
fields.records/skill:3:137/skill/warnings/0/tex: Despite the full description, a Dervish enchantment is removed even if this attack fails to hit.
fields.records/skill:3:372/skill/warnings/0/tex: This is the only skill that has health degeneration shown with positive value in the description.
fields.records/skill:3:373/skill/warnings/0/tex: This enchantment can be cast while under the effects of Frozen Soil.
fields.records/skill:3:374/skill/warnings/0/tex: When sorting skills by campaign, this is listed under Core although it's a Nightfall skill.
fields.records/skill:3:377/skill/warnings/0/tex: If two people cast this spell on one target, both will take effect; however, only one enchantment will show on the effects monitor.
fields.records/skill:3:377/skill/warnings/1/tex: The heal amount is based on your rank of Divine Favor at the time of each hit rather than at the initial casting, i.e. if your attributes are increased/decreased while the enchantment is in effect, the heal amount will change accordingly.
fields.records/skill:3:377/skill/warnings/2/tex: This skill actually causes health gain.
fields.records/skill:3:378/skill/warnings/0/tex: Contrary to the description, the healing from this skill is gained through life stealing rather than a heal. fields.records/skill:3:378/skill/warnings/1/tex: The distance of healing is much greater than spirit range and it seems that healing covers all the current location.
fields.records/skill:3:378/skill/warnings/2/tex: The Spirit of Vampirism's attack skill is a monster skill independent of the Sunspear rank. fields.records/skill:4:295/skill/warnings/1/tex: If you obtain a new skill (as a quest reward) you may equip it in any of the free slots and use it. After turning back to human form, you keep the skill but cannot use it until you swap it with another skill.
fields.records/skill:4:296/skill/warnings/0/tex: Although it is classified as a Form, the caster does not change appearance.
fields.records/skill:4:297/skill/warnings/0/tex: Unlike other skills without an activation time, this skill has the standard aftercast delay of 0.75 second and cannot be used while moving or activating another skill.
fields.records/skill:4:298/skill/warnings/0/tex: Foes affected by this skill cannot miss.
fields.records/skill:4:298/skill/warnings/1/tex: While target foe is hexed, you cannot miss other foes.
fields.records/skill:4:298/skill/warnings/2/tex: This hex also prevents the target from blocking your attacks.
fields.records/skill:4:299/skill/warnings/0/tex: Unlike most enchantments, Mental Block does not show a cloudy white ring around the caster.
fields.records/skill:4:304/skill/warnings/0/tex: The description is misleading: you can have one active Asura Summon per player.
fields.records/skill:4:305/skill/warnings/0/tex: The description is misleading: you can have one active Asura Summon per player.
fields.records/skill:4:306/skill/warnings/0/tex: The description is misleading: you can have one active Asura Summon per player.

fields.records/skill:4:307/skill/warnings/1/tex: Unlike regular Ruby Djinn, the creature summoned by this skill is fleshy.
fields.records/skill:4:308/skill/warnings/0/tex: Exception: this skill will not daze Murakai, Lady of the Night, a boss-like foe.
fields.records/skill:4:308/skill/warnings/1/tex: Technobabble's damage respects armor, even though it deals untyped damage.
fields.records/skill:4:310/skill/warnings/0/tex: This skill deals fire damage that does not ignore armor.
fields.records/skill:4:311/skill/warnings/0/tex: This skill has no aftercast delay.
fields.records/skill:4:314/skill/warnings/0/tex: If recast before the duration ends, Dwarven Stability will end before being reapplied, triggering Meditation and other relevant skills.
fields.records/skill:4:314/skill/warnings/1/tex: This skill has no aftercast delay.
fields.records/skill:4:319/skill/warnings/0/tex: This attack is not affected by Favourable Winds extra damage even when used wielding a bow, unlike similar flat armor ignoring damage attack skills like Needling Shot or Power Shot.
fields.records/skill:4:320/skill/warnings/0/tex: Attack skills that deal entirely armor-ignoring damage, such as Banishing Strike, are still increased.
fields.records/skill:4:326/skill/warnings/0/tex: The armor bonus while fighting Charr is calculated as two sources, the initial +24 armor and then the +24 armor against Charr. The armor bonus is therefore capped at +25 armor due to effect stacking (giving a 35.2% damage reduction bonus).
fields.records/skill:4:328/skill/warnings/0/tex: The Assassin doesn't shadow step; it is spawned directly next to the target.
fields.records/skill:4:328/skill/warnings/1/tex: The Assassin is counted as a created creature for Spirit's Gift, Explosive Growth, and Boon of Creation. However, it does not count as a summoned creature and is not affected by Spawning Power. Despite this classification, it is not affected by sulfur.
fields.records/skill:4:328/skill/warnings/2/tex: Though the Assassin does not count towards the minion cap, summoning one will cause the game to check the players minion control limit, potentially destroying any minions over the limit.
fields.records/skill:4:328/skill/warnings/3/tex: The Assassin does not always target the foe targeted by the caster, but instead targets the foe closest to its creation point.
fields.records/skill:4:328/skill/warnings/4/tex: Very rarely, the assassin may survive indefinitely. This can occur if resurrected by an enemy-created Restoration spirit, as by Reborn Irukandji.
fields.records/skill:4:330/skill/warnings/0/tex: When sorting skills by type in the Skills and Attributes Panel, this skill is under its own "Melee Attack" category, while all the other melee attacks are in a separate "Melee Attack" category.
fields.records/skill:4:335/skill/warnings/0/tex: This skill ignores the effects of skills that provide health bonuses, such as Endure Pain, when calculating 50% of the health; the target's health needs to be 50% of what it would be without the bonus.
fields.records/skill:4:336/skill/warnings/0/tex: Unlike most shouts, "I Am the Strongest!" ends if it's reapplied before it expires, triggering the effects of echoes.
fields.records/skill:4:337/skill/warnings/0/tex: Similarly to Illusionary Weaponry and Mantra of Signets, the armor provided by this skill is only applied at the end of the armor calculation. As such, it is not counted in the bonus armor cap of +25 and is not reduced by Armor penetration.
fields.records/skill:4:340/skill/warnings/0/tex: The description omits to mention that all pets in the party are affected as well.
fields.records/skill:4:340/skill/warnings/1/tex: The concise description omits that the additional damage only applies to attacks.
fields.records/skill:4:340/skill/warnings/2/tex: The actual range is in the area.

fields.records/skill:3:116/skill/pvp/conciseDes: Elite Chant. (4…9…10 seconds.) Party members in earshot have 50% chance to block. Ends when hitting with an attack skill.
fields.records/skill:3:122/skill/pvp/conciseDes: Elite Chant. (10 seconds.) Party members in earshot gain 45…97…110 Health with their next skill.
fields.records/skill:3:130/skill/pvp/conciseDes: Elite Form. (10…74…90 seconds.) Deal holy damage. You lose 1 hex whenever you use a Dervish attack skill. Heal yourself for 5…41…50 Health whenever you lose a Dervish enchantment. This skill is disabled for 45 seconds.
fields.records/skill:3:133/skill/pvp/conciseDes: Elite Form. (10…74…90 seconds.) You have +100 maximum Health, +30 elemental armor, and your attacks deal earth damage. Cure 2 conditions from yourself whenever you lose a Dervish enchantment. This skill is disabled for 45 seconds.
fields.records/skill:3:137/skill/pvp/conciseDes: Elite Scythe Attack. Inflicts Bleeding condition (5…17…20 seconds). Removes 1 Dervish enchantment. Removal effect: inflicts Deep Wound condition (5…17…20 seconds).
fields.records/skill:3:139/skill/pvp/conciseDes: Elite Flash Enchantment Spell. (2…7…8 seconds.) You attack and gain adrenaline 25% faster.
fields.records/skill:1:163/skill/pvp/warnings/0: Contrary to the description, Peace and Harmony doesn't cause conditions and hexes to expire 90% faster. Instead, all new conditions and hexes, applied during the enchantment, will have their duration reduced by 90%.
fields.records/skill:1:195/skill/pvp/warnings/0: Contrary to the descriptions, this skill causes healing and not health gain.
fields.records/skill:1:197/skill/pvp/warnings/0: This skill does not actually become disabled, as it can be instantly recharged by Glyph of Renewal, and the recharge reduced by Glyph of Swiftness.

fields.records/boss:1:5a42971dd168bdf1/npc/note:
*Unlike other scarabs, she is a ranged attacker.
*Sometimes she is hidden at first and won't pop up until a party member approaches her spawn point. 
*She is surrounded by several Scarab Nest Builders who use lots of traps. Melee characters should be especially careful.
*The Scarab Nest Builders surrounding Kepkhet won't move if attacked from flatbow or longbow range.
*Kepkhet can be pulled and won't return to the nest if at least one of the Scarab Nest Builders has been killed.
*If she casts Mark of Protection on herself, applying a condition or hex will cause her to use Contemplation of Purity which will remove Mark of Protection.
*Aurek the Scarab Hunter in Augury Rock (outpost) tells you of her existence and that he has been hunting her.

* Quickroot can be most easily found by entering Lornar's Pass from Beacon's Perch. He will be just off-radar to the left, on top of the hill. He shares this spawning location with Clobberhusk, Poisonbough, and non-boss Pinesouls, so it may be necessary to zone a few times in order to find him. It might be a good idea to check the two topmost spawnpoints each time you enter Lornar's Pass.
* He is hard to kill with the low level henchmen from Beacon's Perch, so it is recommended that you bring heroes or have a friend with heroes help you.

fields.records/boss:1:70bea95402944c75/npc/note:
* Frostbite has three possible spawn locations in Talus Chute, which he shares with three other Nightmare bosses.
* The easiest way to find him in Talus Chute is to repeatedly zone from Camp Rankor until he spawns at the closest location, which allows for finding him with minimal effort.
* He hardly ever spawns in the Ice Floe. On the other hand, be aware that he will only appear once you approach his location, which is near the tree in the center of the small area enclosed by a low wall right outside the gate of Thunderhead Keep. When Frostbite appears, 12 Azure Shadows will pop up from the ground and they can kill your whole party with a Signet of Judgment spike, so spread out.

fields.records/boss:1:fcb697c497783292/npc/note:
* This boss can appear in any of the four possible spawn locations, which he shares with Nayl Klaw Tuthan and Rwek Khawl Mawl.
* Does not always spawn, if he is not at the four locations above, rezone and try again.
* Immediately upon zoning into Perdition Rock, you can turn left and check one of his spawn locations without having to fight anything. You can keep rezoning until he does show up. 
* In hard mode, without some form of dedicated interrupt, this boss can be very difficult to defeat, especially with the Hydras that it is grouped with. A Wurm may also spawn in this area and make the battle even harder.
* This boss attacks with a hammer, even though its profession is Monk.

fields.records/boss:1:9fbdad08885483b6/npc/note:
* Once a player gets in radar range of his location, Harn Coldstone will spawn and begin his patrol around the island. He moves through many enemy mobs, which can make catching up with him complicated; be careful to not aggro too many enemies accidentally. See Harn and Maxine Coldstone (Zaishen quest) for additional strategies.
* He shares his spawn point with Maxine Coldstone, so only one of them can be present at one time. If you see Maxine, then Harn won't be on the map, and vice-versa.
* Harn is less likely to spawn than Maxine.
* He is the only Enchanted boss without the word Custodian in his name, and who is not located in the Crystal Desert.
*Unlike other Elementalists, he attacks at melee range.
Unlike most Enchanted, this boss is considered fleshy.

fields.records/boss:1:aa9313472b0ea40c/npc/note:
* Strategy: After killing the two Chaos Wurms, head to the left side and kill the popups (there is no need to go to the right side (unless farming for ecto)). From the left side stairway, target the nearest Terrorweb Dryder and pull with a bow. That will pull the Darknesses as well, but if you back up enough the Darknesses will return, and the Dryders will still follow you. Do not retreat too far or the Dryders will break aggro and return.
** This pull usually only works once, once the Dryders return they cannot be pulled away again. Kill the Dryders and then the Darknesses will be alone. This is a good strategy for players that solo farm the Tomb of the Primeval Kings.

* Unlike other zombies, it does not take double damage from holy damage.

* Certain areas past the bridge around Rotscale periodically inflicts poison on party members and allies.
* You can pay for two buffs after summoning a Champion of Balthazar at the statue of Balthazar near the bridge to Rotscale:

** Holy Blessing for {{cost|50}}: +25 maximum health and +3 health regeneration.

This is useful because it can be used to pull him and his group onto the bridge where two Canthan Guards will engage him and they will be standing together so area of effect skills affect most of them, possibly making the fight easier.
** Even if you approach from the north, Orosen and his group runs to the Senji's Corner portal as soon as you enter compass range of their initial location. They start fighting the Canthan Guards around the portal when you get in compass range of their new location.
* It is highly advisable to pre-apply protection and keep your party spread out, because of Orosen's potentially high spike damage.

* The boss spawns with another Dredge Gardener and can be very hard to kill.
* Scourge Healing and Scourge Enchantment help to turn the battle in your favor.
* It is recommended to bring skills that punish and/or remove enchantments or skills like Backfire, Visions of Regret and Spirit Shackles to lower his energy and health fast.
* This boss is found in an area with lots of patrolling groups of Dredge. Be sure to clear these groups out individually before engaging this boss, as these patrols can quickly stack numbers against you.

* Occasionally, his group will not spawn when you enter the bosses range. Instead, they will spawn when you spawn either Bezzr Wingstorms or Bazzr Icewings group. This can be confusing when vanquishing.
* There are a few monsters with very similar names, possibly a family name within the game.
** Chkkr Brightclaw
** Chkkr Ironclaw
** Chkkr Locust Lord

* The easiest route is from the Eternal Grove, but it will always be through Kurzick territory.
* Although Wingstorm requires 9 Domination Magic, Bezzr does not use skills of that attribute. 
* Some players consider the 200 wanding damage done by this Mesmer boss in Hard mode to be abnormally strong.

fields.records/boss:3:30f1c65d09f26945/npc/note:
*Protective Spirit and similar enchantments can help with the damage reduction.
*Enchantment removal will counter Twin Moon Sweep.
*Consider bringing another Signet of Capture to get Reaper's Sweep from Dabineh Deathbringer.
fields.records/boss:3:367edea3cbb2538a/npc/note:
* Sergeant Behnwa has an Elder Hyena for an animal companion. It cannot be charmed.
* The fastest way to reach him is from Sunspear Sanctuary (as part of a GoD run). Second from Venta Cemetery (storyline) and third from Gate of Desolation. His Kournan group stands near a bridge often used to cross the explorable area.
fields.records/boss:3:fbc8b2772be606df/npc/note:
* In Hard mode, Korr can easily wipe an entire party due to fire damage as high as 400 from Searing Flames. Consider using an interrupt such as Signet of Humility, Power Block, or Complicate to disable Searing Flames. 
* Alternately, you can reduce damage with Ward Against Elements or Ward Against Harm and use Pain Inverter to quickly dispatch the boss. This method is particularly useful when the party has a minion master or spirit spammer.
fields.records/boss:3:d17e801dc65669fb/npc/note: * This boss may not spawn when the quest Weird Waters is active. However, if he does spawn, his group will attack the heket groups that are related to the aforementioned quest.
fields.records/boss:3:a8403b49fb81e2c1/npc/note: * Commander Noss is inaccessible during the quest To Kill a Demon
fields.records/boss:3:6706af0dcd91d1f8/npc/note:
*If you have not completed the quest Drakes on the Plain yet, make sure you don't include Koss in your party, otherwise Zelnehlun Fastfoot will not spawn.
*To trigger Zelnehlun Fastfoot and his mob, walk towards the resurrection shrine near the fortress.
fields.records/boss:3:da0eb89bc95cfd79/npc/note:
* Jerneh Nightbringer, together with a large mob, will only appear once the players have approached his location.
* Curiously, Jerneh's ambush consists of both skale and heket.
fields.records/boss:3:8601b81f75298d21/npc/note:
* The Drought is a non-demonic servant of Abaddon; Lightbringer's Gaze is useless against it.
* The following tactics are effective in dealing with the Drought:
** Winter will negate the bonuses from earth damage.
** The Drought can be shutdown by daze, Power Block or knock downs. 
** Pain Inverter is even more effective using a minion master to exploit Sandstorm's area of effect damage — the more minions that get hit, the more damage there is to invert.
** Protective Spirit is effective, since the Drought almost always hits for over 200 damage.
** Shelter provides enough party-wide protection to kill the Drought using the Pain Inverter strategy (it generally will not survive more than one Sandstorm).
fields.records/boss:3:df06c41da5fe9cb2/npc/note:
* This boss can hit for large amounts of damage. It is recommended to spread your team to avoid its area of effect attacks.
* This boss relies almost entirely on physical damage, so blocking and causing its attacks to miss are effective ways to prevent damage.
fields.records/boss:3:bada5a660e3a6236/npc/note: *When it is aggroed, Mandragor Imps will popup.
fields.records/boss:3:135116e4c695cc71/npc/note:

fields.records/boss:3:3f767e403bc41f57/npc/note: * Churrta the Rock will not spawn if the quest Eavesdropping is active.
fields.records/boss:3:15cc22e850e04a74/npc/note: *He spawns very close to several other bosses. Players working on their Skill Hunter title may wish to bring several Signets of Capture with them.

fields.records/boss:3:75f946f31bb66ed1/npc/note: * This boss is hidden and only appears once you're close to him.
fields.records/boss:3:affb272b947cc0cf/npc/note: * Killing this boss will cause you to fail Masters for the mission, so you may want to go back and capture the elite skill after completing the mission or you can capture it from Chidehkir, Light of the Blind in Marga Coast.
fields.records/boss:3:55959f0f94fafc4f/npc/note: Though Lumanda has a feminine appearance, he is referred to with male pronouns in the mission dialogue.
fields.records/boss:3:5bc996f7ffeac3b6/npc/note: This boss does not spawn. The solution to this bug [{{fullurl:Feedback_talk:Emily_Diehl|diff=1967523}} was known by ArenaNet], but was never implemented.
fields.records/boss:3:bb486cee56080160/npc/note:
* Elementalists capping the skill may wish to bring a second Signet of Capture, as an Elementalist boss with Master of Magic is along the way.
* This boss deals heavy damage in Hard mode. Consider bringing damage reduction skills such as Protective Spirit or "Save Yourselves!", or caster shutdown methods in form of interrupts or dazed. Spreading out before engaging Lushivahr will also prevent Invoke Lightning from hitting multiple party members.
fields.records/boss:3:b93b97420601b816/npc/note:
* In hard mode, Master of Magic does not increase nor decrease its rank 16 Earth Magic, since rank 20 Energy Storage causes Master of Magic to set elemental attribute ranks to 16.
* Elementalists capping Master of Magic may wish to bring a second Signet of Capture, as an Elementalist boss with Invoke Lightning is in the area.
fields.records/boss:3:d7097b282f55612e/npc/note:
* Be extremely careful of this boss' Spirit Rift. In Normal Mode, the amount of damage this skill can do is already high, but in Hard mode, it is capable of dealing 500+ damage to each character, easily killing all of a clumped group. When he uses Spirit Rift you have 3 seconds to flag your heroes away.
* Bohdalz the Furious spawns near Jarimiya the Unmerciful. If seeking the least amount of foes possible, see the path on Jarimiya the Unmerciful's page.
fields.records/boss:3:b929f0d6a5fe17d7/npc/note:
* This boss always drops one Bottle of Vabbian Wine when it dies, although it can be assigned to NPCs, such as henchmen, heroes or Vabbian Guards (in which case you will not see the drop).
** All enemy groups between the portal to Forum Highlands and Jarimiya can be pulled towards the nearby groups of Vabbian Guards for extra help when solo farming; this includes the group of Bohdalz the Furious.
fields.records/boss:3:ef5bd75d237b1c21/npc/note: * The boss is located near a "Do Not Touch" treasure. Be sure to kill off her group before going for that treasure.
fields.records/boss:3:341d9b0d5f622963/npc/note:

It helps to bring AoE skills such as interrupts (e.g. Panic or Psychic Instability), knock downs (e.g. Meteor), or daze (e.g. Broad Head Arrow).

fields.records/boss:3:3836e0f5079ee740/npc/note:
* He can spawn in a team with 1-2 Skree Griffins.
* Healer's Boon makes this a hard boss to defeat, though standard caster counters work wonders on him (daze, knockdowns, enchantment removal, interrupts, etc).
* If a Skree Singer spawns in the group they can resurrect Josinq the Whisperer using "We Shall Return!". This can make killing him difficult as he will use his Renew Life to resurrect the Singer if it is killed nearby. Consider Frozen Soil.

fields.records/boss:3:03a2d2f3fc4e61f6/npc/note:

Sometimes Bansheh, Gatherer of Branches will not spawn even if the above quests are not active.
fields.records/boss:3:63a3c26bd5f00811/npc/note:

This boss has been observed to throw shields.
fields.records/boss:3:198d0ded4834b2e5/npc/note:

fields.records/boss:3:0ca3db40f9ce99e8/npc/note: *This boss may not spawn if the quest Coffer of Joko has not been completed, and Master of Whispers is in your party. See the talk page for more information.
fields.records/boss:3:d54977e994778b92/npc/note: * Avah the Crafty is the second boss to appear while battling the waves of undead during the Gate of Desolation mission.

fields.records/boss:3:2cba94ddf479ed50/npc/note: * This boss is very close to the entrance to the Lair of the Forgotten. A Wurm Spoor is nearby, making it very easy to farm Dunshek and his entire group in Junundu form.
fields.records/boss:3:d984d9981589d63f/npc/note: * If traveling to Saushali to capture Magebane Shot, one might consider taking another signet of capture as Uhiwi the Smoky with Smoke Trap is along the route.
fields.records/boss:3:bdebb401230f3fd7/npc/note:

fields.records/boss:3:a39f361ce38bc791/npc/note: * Uhiwi the Smoky with Smoke Trap is also in the area.
fields.records/boss:3:6e75211c9e79efb5/npc/note: * Sometimes this boss might not spawn if the quests Under New Management or The Scourge of Vabbi are active.
fields.records/boss:3:37ce2033e35dd026/npc/note: *Occasionally two Desert Wurms will spawn in the group surrounding this boss. If this occurs, taking out the Desert Wurms first will make killing the rest of the group easier.
fields.records/boss:3:23c6b7775baa1959/npc/note: * If you run a spirits build you may consider Vanquishing this zone when capping the skill as it works extremely well with Signet of Spirits.
fields.records/boss:3:66d7574b1fb5b964/npc/note: * Droajam, Mage of the Sands is also present in the explorable and though it's a fair trek it may be useful to take two Signets of Capture for the other Elementalist elite (Sandstorm).
fields.records/boss:3:491efbd53d6bb93b/npc/note:
*Consider bringing two Signets of Capture, as Mekir the Prismatic, the boss carrying Ether Prism, is in this area.

fields.records/boss:3:7b60317105770f62/npc/note:

fields.records/boss:3:cdffcd6e11938b65/npc/note: * Several Istani Cultists can be found around it. They will attack if you approach.

fields.records/boss:3:807391e55d9a0f57/npc/note:
* Saevio Proelium is mentioned in the quests A Brief Introduction and Between a Rock...
* He usually spawns with 3-5 Pain Titans.
fields.records/boss:3:43a11d4b3c882e35/npc/note: * The Margonites that are grouped with this boss are flanked by two groups of Torment creatures. Careful separation of the mobs is recommended.
fields.records/boss:3:e97a600c0b4a69a2/npc/note:
* The path shown on the map can be quite difficult due to the 3 closely gathered groups of Margonites and Torment creatures on the other side. Still, it is possible to lure one group away from the others. An alternative would be to take a right turn in front of the bridge and follow the path from there on (staying near the west edge of the path) until one goes around to cross a black bridge that leads directly to the boss. There are small mobs along the way, but this should be remedied with a decent party. This is a longer, but safer way to approach the boss without having to suffer any sort of death penalty.

fields.records/boss:3:7270e6f4725a5b3f/npc/note:
* Because Soul Torture has a very long activation time without technically doing anything, consider waiting until the Tortureweb Dryder begins activating it before entering its aggro and engaging it. Avoid using interrupt skills or attacking it with weapons (because Soul Torture is easily interruptible) during this time.
* Make sure to spread out to prevent heavy area of effect damage from Liquid Flame and Fireball, which could overwhelm healers if not careful.
fields.records/boss:3:d5619951d86d37ba/npc/note: *This boss uses ranged attacks instead of its dagger attack skills.

fields.records/boss:3:2ee2d3ff6a735533/npc/note: *Caution while engaging this foe is advised, as fighting will most likely take place on said bridge, leaving less space to maneuver but exalting the tactical value of a Ranger's traps at the same time.

*Exuro Flatus cannot attack.

*A group of Shadow Army foes can walk within Exuro's area, making farming difficult.

*When slain, the enemies that spawn after it may not necessarily appear immediately. If they do not, move closer to where the Greater Darkness was defeated.

fields.records/boss:3:06f6ae5c11a412ec/npc/note:
* To make the fight easier draw him away from his spawn point towards the City of Torc'qua. Putting your casters behind the fortress wall will allow them to cast spells in relative safety (Jadoth and his ranged allies will be unable to hit them).
** Alternatively there is a cliff on the other side of the fortress. Hiding your casters beneath that cliff will yield similar results.
* Jadoth's group has two monks, make sure to take enough anti-healing skills.
* He is very powerful and will make short work of parties approaching him when allowing him to cast his Storm of Judgment too often. Soothing Images and Diversion are effective counters.
* A Spirit of Truth will spawn near to the reward Chest after his death.

fields.records/boss:4:0709d32e56924368/npc/note: * This boss has a large patrol path in the northwestern section of the area. His group travels either in a clockwise or counter-clockwise manner, which can make encountering them difficult.
fields.records/boss:4:4d5216a92d9f9e91/npc/note:
* While he uses predominantly warrior skills (including his elite), he has a paragon aura and will drop paragon tomes.
* The cave where this boss is located serves to farm Archaic Maul in regular quantities, it's one of the common items that the Kveldulf can drop.
fields.records/boss:4:8f3576f20a1dcab8/npc/note: * You do not have to kill him to complete the quest In the Service of Revenge.
fields.records/boss:4:857c56565f03a8ea/npc/note: * Unlike many bosses in Eye of the North, he does not possess Natural Resistance.
fields.records/boss:4:1ea5162f911bbe34/npc/note:
* Jormungand spawns alongside two Frost Wurms.
* If the boss does not appear, a solitary Frozen Elemental or Frost Wurm will sometimes spawn instead.
** Some players believe that the appearance of these other foes at any potential spawning location means that Jormungand will not appear in the current instance. However, no one has published sufficient research to confirm or deny this theory.
fields.records/boss:4:82a8fe0418eaf508/npc/note:
