*Sometimes, Koren and his group will be killed by other monsters in the area, making it seem as if they never spawned. This will not update the quest.
fields.records/boss:4:9e7e9d861db40630/npc/note:
* Approaching or flagging a hero to Nulfastu's tree will lead to spawning all enemies, some of which will remain level 5 rabbits.
* On the Notorious Foe signpost and in all linked quests his name has a comma: Nulfastu, Earthbound. However, the name of the NPC himself does not contain a comma.
fields.records/boss:4:16146d8ec7d7bea2/npc/note:
* She doesn't use her own scythe, but an Asuran Scythe.
* Myish, Lady Of The Lake is at the center of Drakkar Lake, surrounded by groups of Frozen Elementals and Chilling Wisps with wide patrol paths. Consider dispatching the patrols with careful pulling before confronting the boss.
* The frozen lake around Myish causes Icy Ground, however she may be lured to a little island to the southwest, therefore negating the environmental effect.
fields.records/boss:4:65ffdfc5ee45426a/npc/note: * He will spawn from the start, but not become hostile until all other points in the quest have been cleared.
fields.records/boss:4:d0c12b704c0b7e54/npc/note: * In normal mode, it takes him 8-10 minutes to patrol his route. In hard mode, he will run his route in 2 minutes.

fields.records/boss:4:f937cf5d1b8d2776/npc/note:
* Upon coming within range of the Stone Summit Gnashers, they will begin a dialogue to "summon" Lord Glacius.
** If you attack the group before the summoning is complete, they may end their dialogue early. The summoning process will still complete when the dialogue would have finished as long as one of the Gnashers is alive. If you kill all of the Gnashers before they complete the summoning, Lord Glacius the Eternal will not appear.
fields.records/boss:4:e7e3494d9ba36bc7/npc/note: * In the German language version they are called "Lissah der Rudelführer" which would indicate they are male (otherwise it would be "Lissah die Rudelführerin").
fields.records/boss:4:931e64e70b9935df/npc/note:
*He is a warrior in Jaga Moraine and uses the Stone Summit Herder model.
*He is a monk in Sorrow's Furnace and uses a Stone Summit Taskmaster model
**He is an ally due to Chains of Enslavement.
fields.records/boss:4:5311e586df981c40/npc/note:
* He is one of the bosses to be killed for the quest Anything You Can Do. When you approach him a number of Bone Fiends will appear. These Bone Fiends are not minions, thus he can't use Taste of Death on them and his Dark Bond won't work either. Also, Verata's Aura and Verata's Gaze cannot gain control of these creatures. 
* Although he is a Norn, he does not use Bear Form because he fell from the grace of the Bear Spirit.
* Despite this being an 8 person area, it is possible to take the route shown, defeating very few mobs along the way, to reach and defeat this boss with a 4 person team. That can help improve the odds of receiving the unique weapon drop.
fields.records/boss:4:095c9568020d08fd/npc/note:
* It does huge amounts of AoE damage and often causes knockdown.
* Replaced by Edielh Shockhunter after completion of Prenuptial Disagreement.
* Pain Inverter will be useful, as it will trigger more often due to the AoE, and additionally up to three times per ally because of Shockwave.
* This boss, like most Wurm bosses, does not need to be killed when vanquishing as long as it is not above ground.
* If this boss dies while underground, you will not be able to capture skills from it.
fields.records/boss:4:458e21dd2c15bd4e/npc/note:
* Whiteout resides at the top of a steep rise, on a narrow path. 
** Beware of tumbling boulders that can instantly kill anyone in their path. 
** If you are using heroes and/or henchmen, flag them at the bottom of the rise, the walk up the path to trigger the boulders so that you can more easily dodge them.
* Whiteout is accompanied by an Avalanche and two Ice Elementals, but is very vulnerable to fire damage.
** Focus everyone's attack on Whiteout and he will go down quickly. After killing him your party will be able to take out the rest of the enemies.
** To farm this boss, rezone at the nearby Frostmaw's Burrows dungeon portal.
fields.records/boss:4:e2ff365e01c693a5/npc/note: *Try to take out the patrols nearby before you attempt to kill him or you might find yourself overwhelmed.
fields.records/boss:4:23ca569f745d05e6/npc/note:
* When close to the edge of the player's compass, Molotov Rocktail will begin a patrol to the north east and continue a short way into the forest.
* His Devourer Siege can easily wipe out a party that is not spread out; flag heroes and henchmen around or underneath him and either interrupt or blind him, preventing both his Devourer Siege and Power Attack.
* You can tank Rocktail using the nearby Siege Devourer: since it rarely uses Devourer Siege once in melee, you can use the durability of the Siege Devourer to approach it alone and lock it in melee safely, even in hard mode.
* Molotov Rocktail has an extended aggro range, much like Kournan Spotters.
* Due to Devourer Siege, Pain Inverter is very effective, since it reflects damage from your minions, spirits, summons, and animal companions.
fields.records/boss:4:07bad902f0752ff8/npc/note: * The Flaming Scepter Mages replace Hodat and the accompanying group of Stone Furies before completion of Forgotten Relics.
fields.records/boss:4:7f58016728744cd5/npc/note: *Groknar Weazlewortz was named by You Will Know Fear through the 2007 Brand The Boss contest.
fields.records/boss:4:14540d106bccc048/npc/note: *It is possible that Gordam Griefgiver is from the same Warband as Blazefiend Griefblade.
fields.records/boss:4:164c15ace90f4d85/npc/note:
* Care must be taken with this group (and the other groups of Burning Spirits), as they have a wide patrol range and can quickly ambush and wipe your group while fighting other enemies. They are also highly resistant to fire damage and immune to burning, so other categories of elemental spells should be used against them. 
* Consider bringing AoE interrupts such as Cry of Frustration, Tease, or a ranger with Choking Gas. 
:* The interrupt Complicate, when used on Searing Flames, is particularly effective as it will shut down the entire mob's main source of damage.
* Hex Eater Vortex and Shatter Hex can also be useful in removing Mark of Rodgort from melee characters and dealing large armor-ignoring damage to nearby foes. 
* Pre-interrupts such as Guilt and Mistrust can help in interrupting the multiple copies of Searing Flames.
* Winter will prevent Mark of Rodgort and the spike damage from Searing Flames from triggering and significantly boost damage from your elemental sources.
* Elementalists should consider bringing Frigid Armor to effectively prevent any damage from Searing Flames.
fields.records/boss:4:7eb06b8036c18f54/npc/note:
*You need to have done the Assault on the Stronghold mission before you will be able to reach him.
*He will not spawn if you have the quest Forbidden Fruit active.
fields.records/boss:4:723d92a611d37586/npc/note:
* As a hammer warrior, he can be handled with any anti-melee build.
* As with Borrguus Blisterbark, it is a good idea to kill the roving patrols of Burning Spirits before you take him and his group on, otherwise it is very likely that you will get ambushed and likely wiped out.
* Ignus is the only Titan boss who does not follow the typical naming convention of Titan bosses of two pseudo-Latin words.
fields.records/boss:4:1302217bd86d741e/npc/note:
* The fight is made difficult by the large number of both Grawl Champions and Grawl Dark Priests which surround him. Approaching him from the south, four of the closest Grawl Champions can be pulled away from the group, but all the others attack cohesively along with the boss.
* Area-of-effect anti-melee hexes such as Meekness and Enfeebling Blood are very useful, along with wards such as Ward Against Melee and Ebon Battle Standard of Courage. As always, a minion master can greatly help redirect damage from the team.
fields.records/boss:4:e08cf5197aedb967/npc/note: * A Charr Effigy will spawn once he is aggroed.
fields.records/boss:4:fcc20e749a612a20/npc/note: * As with various quest-related foes, once it spawns, it might cause an additional Locked Chest to spawn.
fields.records/boss:4:a8371f2754b82690/npc/note:
* His route is approximately 5 minutes in length, varying in direction and path per spawn. It patrols around the edge of the northeastern lagoon more often than the south route.
* Flannuss usually becomes stuck on a cliff almost directly south of Vlox's Falls, at the northernmost tip of the land jutting into the river delta - marked with the monk icon on the wiki map. The quickest way to locate the boss should be to travel clockwise on the red path. Alternatively, wait in the spot where it may get stuck - both patrol routes overlap here.
* An easy (but repetitive) method for killing Flannuss is to zone into Arbor Bay from Vlox's Falls head forward, killing the first two groups of Krait and heading left along the cliff tops. If he is not there, he will likely be there in two minutes - otherwise he is on the other route, so rezone and try again.
fields.records/boss:4:ff8222791052a72b/npc/note: * Dragon Slash is his only adrenal skill, limiting its usefulness.
fields.records/boss:4:b69d80e6808beebf/npc/note: * She has an Elder Black Widow as a pet. You cannot charm this Black Widow.
fields.records/boss:4:8c5bdefb24d76b1b/npc/note:
* Gallow Nooseknitter was named by Will Bonner (Hustler Warrior) through the 2007 Brand The Boss contest.
* If you're farming this boss, you can use the portal just southeast of it to rezone and come back.
fields.records/boss:4:7086a2700915a67d/npc/note:
*The Facet of Existence has a random spawn location in Riven Earth. Known spawn locations:
*#Northwest of the Golem Foundry.
*#Directly east from Rata Sum, before the second resurrection shrine.
*#Up the hill slightly southwest of the center resurrection shrine.
*#Northeast of center, northeast of the short bridge north of center, between the northern and northeastern resurrection shrines (see map).
*#Southeast corner, in the raised area overlooking the waterfall from the north.
*As the first spawn point is so close to Rata Sum, it may be worth reloading the map until you get this spawn. It can be reached without combat.
fields.records/boss:4:e3d76e011437c43b/npc/note:
* He can hit hard, so it is advised to take some interrupt skills.
* Spoil Victor and Pain Inverter are very effective against Joffs. Enchantment removal will also help by removing his protective spells.
* Due to the nature of the damage from Shockwave, it is advisable to space out your party as best as you possibly can to avoid a devastating spike which could very well kill your entire party.
* After killing the surrounding enemies, it is possible to lure Joffs to the southeast past a large rock/hill, where he will become stuck as he tries to get back to his spawn. It is then possible to defeat him with minimal casualties as he will simply walk back and forth as you attack him.
fields.records/boss:4:1f3ce10cee0f0a4b/npc/note:
* The Broodmother's cave is just south of the northern exit in Rata Sum. Not far from her spawn point, you can find a Jar of Invigoration; when dropped, it provides 30 energy to all nearby creatures.
* The cave is filled with three large groups of level 15 Raptor Nestlings. Although they deal relatively little damage, they spam Disrupting Stab, preventing your team from using skills effectively. Rekoff herself deals large amounts of damage. Bring a team that can deal effectively with significant amounts of melee and bring interruption counter-tactics.
* Since the cave is so close to Rata Sum, her group is used to farm Asura reputation points and festival trophy drops. The popularity of the farm also means that Claws of the Broodmother are very common and do not trade at a premium.
fields.records/boss:4:06e222e1ef34653d/npc/note:
* You can counter Mobrin's heavy damage with skills that cause weakness or blindness.
* Compared to a regular Tyrannus, Mobrin trades out the anti-block knockdown of Leviathan's Sweep for the cleaving potential of Sweeping Strikes.
fields.records/boss:4:31e68f11c60a9635/npc/note:
* They have the usual golden warrior boss aura, with an additional purple circular inscription aura about the height of their chest.
* Despite being Ettins, they drop Jotun items.
* They appear to be functionally identical to Inscribed Sentries.
fields.records/boss:4:5e81e60b0cb17ca2/npc/note:
* The Facet of Death has a random spawn location in Sparkfly Swamp. Known spawn locations:
*# Eastern edge of the central clearing, up the hill to the south of the easternmost edge of the swamp. 
*# Southeast of center, at the three way crossroads north of the resurrection shrine.
*# In the center of the Agari territory.
*# Northeast of center, at the three way crossroads between the resurrection shrine at the eastern edge of the swamp and Brynn Earthporter's alcove.
fields.records/boss:4:e01c513bbe1c8e21/npc/note:
* A Siege Devourer can be used to easily take down the large mob that accompanies Fureyst Sharpsight, making the battle considerably easier. 
** It is possible to acquire one early directly to the south of Doomlore Shrine in Dalada Uplands. Take then the portal to Grothmar Wardowns then go south to Sacnoth Valley for a slightly faster route.
** In Hard Mode, a Siege Devourer will spawn near Fureyst Sharpsight. With a runner it is possible to quickly reach Rragar's Menagerie, zone there, then reenter Sacnoth Valley, take the devourer and proceed from there. The runner can still be useful in combat by mounting the devourer themselves.
